# JustLatent Full Documentation & Catalogue Context (justlatent.com)

Welcome to JustLatent (https://justlatent.com/), the comprehensive, community-driven free archive for the viral comedy show **India's Got Latent**, hosted by Samay Raina.

## About the Platform
JustLatent provides high-definition video streaming for all released episodes of India's Got Latent, including member-exclusive bonus episodes, behind-the-scenes footage, and deleted clips.

- Primary Domain: https://justlatent.com/
- Contact Support: hello@justlatent.com
- Pricing: Free community service, no paywall, no registration required.

## API Documentation
1. `GET /api/feed`
   Returns real-time JSON array of current video streams and scraped episode metadata.
2. `GET /api/stream?id={okcdnId}`
   Resolves high-quality 720p and 480p CDN video stream URLs for playback.
3. `GET /api/active-domain`
   Returns the current active CDN proxy domain URL.
